bio.text: Brian S. Evans, a Republican from Cabot, serves as Speaker of the House for the 95th General Assembly and represents House District 68, which includes Cabot and portions of Lonoke County; he is serving his fourth term.
Evans is president of L&L Freight Services, Inc., and is the former chairman of the board of the Transportation Intermediaries Association.
He previously served 10 years on the Cabot School Board and attended the University of Central Arkansas and Arkansas State University.
